verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm offering attorney-led visa and green card services, not a software or automation product. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of business. The attorney review of case filings is a professional-service practice, not automation version control, and no evidence shows the firm ships any automation tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
